edges.business_sentence: A Governance Assessment offers a Rule Review Recommendation.
edges.product_consequence: The product may show the recommendation as decision support, but it must not present it as an owner decision.
edges.noncollapse_witness: A recommendation can exist while the authorized owner rejects it or makes no decision.

edges.business_sentence: A Rule Review Recommendation informs a Governance Decision.
edges.product_consequence: The product may carry the recommendation into the decision surface while preserving the decision owner's separate action.
edges.noncollapse_witness: The same recommendation can inform different decisions under different owner authority or later evidence.

edges.business_sentence: A Governance Program requires a Governance Fact Set for one Governance Request.
edges.product_consequence: The product must request only the facts declared by the selected Program and must expose missing requirements instead of scanning or hashing the whole repository.
edges.noncollapse_witness: The same Program can evaluate different Requests using different bounded Fact Sets without changing Program identity or lifecycle.

edges.business_sentence: A Governance Request is evaluated under one Governance Program.
edges.product_consequence: The product must show which Program was used without presenting that Program as the owner decision or requested consequence.
edges.noncollapse_witness: The same Request can be evaluated under a simulation Program and an accepted Program while remaining the same proposed consequence and producing differently bounded results.

edges.business_sentence: A Governance Fact Set contains Governance Facts admitted for one evaluation.
edges.product_consequence: The product can explain each consulted Fact and its provenance without implying that the collection is all repository knowledge.
edges.noncollapse_witness: A Fact can be replaced, expire, or be rejected while the Program and Request remain unchanged; the resulting Fact Set is a different value.
edges.owner_route: CyberAlchemy Governance evidence owner with runtime owner review

known_conflicts.statement: The Governance product ontology uses produces for a capability-to-output business relation, while DomainSpec DS-D2 uses produces for an Operation-to-Event relation. Shared spelling does not establish shared semantics or a valid DomainSpec edge.
known_conflicts.owner_route: CyberAlchemy Governance owner plus DomainSpec v2 definitions-governance owner
known_conflicts.next_action: Select a qualified business verb or an explicit bridge only after both meanings and endpoint signatures are reviewed.
